# A Place Beyond

> The audio accompaniment to the book *A Place Beyond* by Garett Strickland — an immersive ambient music experience for reading.

## About

- Site: A PLACE BEYOND | Ambient Music Experience
- Purpose: audio accompaniment to the book *A Place Beyond* (Inside the Castle, ISBN 9798987083895)
- Book: *A Place Beyond* by Garett Strickland, published by Inside the Castle
- Music: the original track "Blackmoon," composed by Garett Strickland
- Book designer: Mike Corrao
- Where to buy the book: https://asterismbooks.com/product/a-place-beyond
- Publisher: https://insidethecastle.org

## Primary page

- [Home](https://aplacebeyond.place/): a single-page immersive ambient experience — looping generative visuals and the original track Blackmoon, playable in the browser.

## Optional

- [The book at Asterism Books](https://asterismbooks.com/product/a-place-beyond): full book details and ordering
- [Inside the Castle (publisher)](https://insidethecastle.org/)
